messages:
joni.r: Morning all 99just started today. Two asks: VPN + GitHub org invite, and a short who-to-cc list for production escalations (I	m shadowing oncall next week).

pat.devex: Hi @joni.r welcome! DM me your GitHub handle and manager. For Slack + repo invites I
 send that info.

infra-bot: Ticket created: INFRA-7620 by joni.r (onboarding access) 9assigned to eng-infra. ETA ~8 business hours.

max.t: For VPN and test GPUs open a request in the infra portal and tag @lee.sre. Small ad-hoc trials (<6h) are usually approved same day.

lee.sre: Ownership snapshot: model serving = eng-runtime, data plane = eng-storage, routing + fallbacks = eng-platform, customer escalation = customer-ops. Escalation ladder: oncall -> service lead -> platform/SRE -> EMs -> CTO-on-call.

hana.hr: Welcome! I just sent the payroll & hardware form. New hire orientation is 10am tomorrow in #all-hands, please join.

joni.r: Super helpful, thanks. One more: who can approve a quick Dedicated test for a research PoC (4 GPUs for 4 hours)?

max.t: Tag @max.t with purpose + cost center in the infra request. I can approve small short trials; anything longer goes via finance.

pat.devex: Adding you to the owners doc and sending a short who-to-cc cheat sheet in DM so you have it when shadowing.

joni.r: Thanks everyone 9appreciate the fast responses!
